title: Index Line Rebill Credit: Over-Billed Amount and Carrying Credit
content:
## Index energy line of the pass-through cycle (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

The pass-through cycle is the cycle that began on the stated effective date of the contract's latest regulatory pass-through notice.

1. The over-billed amount of the pass-through cycle's index line is its billed amount less its index kWh multiplied by the sum of the index price and the index adder and divided by 100, that product rounded half up to the cent, and nothing when the difference is not positive.
2. The index kWh of the index line correction are the cycle's metered kWh, the kWh on all of the cycle's energy lines together.
3. The index price of the index line correction is the index price on the monthly index price notice effective on the cycle's billing period start.
4. The index adder of the index line correction is the contract rate.
5. The index line carrying credit is the over-billed amount multiplied by its carrying rate and by its carrying period, where the carrying period is the whole months from the index line's posted date to the handling date multiplied by 30 days per month and divided by 360 days per year.
6. The index line carrying rate is zero.
7. The index line rebill credit is the over-billed amount plus its carrying credit, rounded half up to the cent and posted as a negative amount.

The latest regulatory pass-through notice is the one with the latest notice date. Whole months are calendar months from the posted date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.

## Worked through (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| billed amount of the cycle's index energy charge line | $26880.00 |
| metered kWh of the cycle | 400000 |
| index price on the notice effective on the cycle's billing period start | 5.90 cents per kWh |
| contract rate | 0.75 cents per kWh |
| correct amount: 400000 multiplied by 5.90 plus 0.75 (6.65), divided by 100 | $26600.00 |
| over-billed amount: 26880.00 less 26600.00 | $280.00 |
| carrying credit at a carrying rate of zero | $0.00 |
| rebill credit | minus $280.00 |

Where the correct amount is equal to or above the billed amount, the over-billed amount is nothing and no credit is posted.
